coder_notes: Only therapeutic intervention is a CAR T-cell product (excluded intervention type); no pharmacological candidate. IL13Ralpha2 is linked to the CAR T target, not to any pharmacological candidate, so candidate_matched false. IDH row reflects that IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 3/4 is an eligible histology (IDH-mutant or glioblastoma), not a strict IDH requirement; could be dropped. CAR T persistence in CSF/tumour is planned but relates to the cell therapy, not a candidate drug, so tumour PK and target engagement coded no. cns5_terminology unclear: record separates IDH-mutant astrocytoma from glioblastoma but neither cites WHO 2021 nor requires IDH-wildtype.
